title: Predicting the risk of postoperative avascular necrosis in patients with talar fractures based on an interpretable machine learning model.
summary: Full primary article reports a retrospective one-center talar-fracture model for postoperative AVN; 45 of 207 patients had AVN and XGBoost led internal testing.
ai_technology: Six ML methods used clinical risk factors; XGBoost and SHAP supported prediction/interpretation.

evidence.tested: Internal validation only; no external replication or outcome improvement evidence.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
evidence.ai_role: Six ML methods used clinical risk factors; XGBoost and SHAP supported prediction/interpretation.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
